name: Sweety Sony Lall

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sweety Sony Lall’s “LITTLE SPARROWS” begins with the emotional surprise of three birds returning to a window. Their presence becomes an imagined conversation about companionship, trust and the possibility of feeling safe together.

The poem moves from the speaker’s tears towards a prayer for the birds’ protection. Its direct address and affectionate tone make an ordinary encounter with small living creatures a moment of reassurance. This attention to the sparrows gives the poem its intimate scale.
